messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, become pregnant, or plan to become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets.
Using fluoxetine later in pregnancy may increase the risk of complications in the newborn.
Some complications require a longer hospital stay.
Some complications require breathing support.
Some complications require tube feeding.
A serious complication is a lung condition called persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN).
Untreated depression carries risks in pregnancy.
Discuss the benefits and risks of treatment with your healthcare provider.
Do not stop treatment on your own.
If you become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets, ask your healthcare provider about joining the National Pregnancy Registry for Antidepressants.
The registry tracks pregnancy outcomes in women who take these medicines.
You can enroll by calling 1-866-961-2388 or visiting womensmentalhealth.org.
Breastfeeding:
Fluoxetine passes into breast milk.
Tell your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.
Triplet: ["untreated depression", "has risk in pregnancy", "unknown"]

The relation 'has risk in pregnancy' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or factor may carry specific risks during pregnancy, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
E. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
